messages:
devops: kicking off asia-south1 pipeline onboarding. primary goals: regional image mirror, GitOps app path, helm chart sync, and prewarm GPU nodes for initial jobs. tagging @jess @omar

jess: thanks — quick checklist? I want PRs for the GitOps app and the registry mirror config so we can review independently.

omar: rough checklist: 1) Artifact mirror (regsync -> Artifact Registry). 2) VPC egress / Cloud NAT / peering for image pulls. 3) GPU nodepool sizing + taints. 4) GitOps pipeline (ArgoCD) + per-region overlays. 5) Prewarm image cache on nodes. 6) Cost estimate + approval.

linh: for the mirror we usually run regsync as a cronjob in infra project and sign images with cosign. example regsync snippet:```yaml
sync:
  - src: gcr.io/redwood-images
    dst: asia-south1-docker.pkg.dev/redwood-prod/images
    filter: "^redwood/.*:prod-.*$"
    mode: incremental
```

tara: what about image pull auth? for GKE we should use Workload Identity + Artifact Registry IAM roles on the KSA used by the regsync job and the node service account for node pulls.

jess: asia-south1 is GKE. plan: create KSA `registry-sync` bound to `roles/artifactregistry.reader`, and use Workload Identity for the regsync pod. Node pool uses node service account with `roles/artifactregistry.reader` as well.

omar: networking callouts: enable Private Google Access and Cloud NAT for private clusters so nodes can pull external layers. if the customer VPC requires ingress restrictions, add proxy rules. watch egress quotas for initial syncs.

deploy-bot: Pipeline job queued: gitops-sync-asia-south1 #4582 — status: pending :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devops: prewarm strategy: spin up 2 GPU nodes (preemptible where acceptable), run `ctr images pull` / `docker pull` against the mirrored registry to populate containerd cache, then run 2 short pods to warm model KV cache. rough cost: ~$140/hr for the two GPUs; request approval for 2h run.

jess: :thumbsup: ok to run 2h, set auto-scale-down to 0 after 2h and alert if prewarm fails. keep logs in `gs://redwood-infra/asia-south1/prewarm/`.

omar: fallback behavior: if mirror lag > 5m, allow nodes to pull from global registry via signed temp URLs (short TTL) and set `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` in overlays. also add alert if regsync lag > 300s.

linh: GitOps/Helm notes: ArgoCD app should point to `infra/gitops/apps/asia-south1` with a values file override. sample helm values override:```yaml
replicaCount: 2
nodeSelector:
  cloud.google.com/gke-accelerator: nvidia-t4
tolerations:
  - key: "nvidia.com/gpu"
    operator: "Exists"
image:
  repository: asia-south1-docker.pkg.dev/redwood-prod/images/service
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
```

tara: I'll watch node joins and taints — ping me if kubelet version mismatch or Nvidia driver install fails. last time in eu-west we had a coscheduler mismatch that blocked GPU scheduling.

jess: post-handoff checklist: add runbook links (regsync job, ArgoCD app, prewarm job logs), cost dashboard, and create alerts/#infra-asia. assign oncall for first 48h monitoring.

omar: creating tracking tickets: INFRA-3285 (registry mirror + IAM), INFRA-3286 (argocd app + helm values), INFRA-3287 (prewarm job + autoscale), INFRA-3288 (networking / Cloud NAT).

deploy-bot: gitops-sync-asia-south1 #4582 started (runner: runner-12) — logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/4582

devops: thanks all — I'll open the PRs and post links here. will close thread once PRs merged and prewarm completes. dropping final checklist to Confluence after handoff.
